title: Mario Kart er morsomt uansett hvor gammel du er, og jeg sykler alltid, ikke bilen

text.Mario Kart is fun no matter how old you: Mario Kart er morsomt uansett hvor gammel du er, og jeg sykler alltid, ikke bilen
Mario Kart er morsomt uansett hvor gammel du er. 🙂‍↕️
text.I have been playing Mario Kart on the Ni: I have been playing Mario Kart on the Nintendo DS since I was in kindergarten.
text.By the way, Japanese people shorten Mari: By the way, Japanese people shorten Mario Kart to "Marikā." We also shorten Netflix to "Netofuri," by the way.
text.What I like in Mario Kart is, first, I l: What I like in Mario Kart is, first, I like a character with a normal weight, about the same body type as Mario. Bowser er for tung, og Baby Mario er for lett, og begge gjør bilen vanskelig å kontrollere.
text.And I like the bike more than the car. I: And I like the bike more than the car. I feel like a bike with fat tires is easier to control.
